# SRv6.md

> The open-source knowledge base for Segment Routing over IPv6 (SRv6).

SRv6.md is a community-driven, MIT-licensed knowledge base covering SRv6 fundamentals, SRv6 for AI networking (GPU backend fabrics, OpenAI's MRC, multi-datacenter training), use cases, vendor implementations, hands-on labs, and RFC references. The full content is available at https://srv6.md/llms-full.txt.

## SRv6 for AI networking

- [SRv6 for AI: The Complete Guide to SRv6 in AI Networks](https://srv6.md/ai/): The reference on SRv6 for AI networking: who runs it (OpenAI, Microsoft, Oracle, Meta, Alibaba, Google), how MRC and uSID source routing work in GPU fabrics, scale-across, standards and FAQ.
- [SRv6 AI Fabric Design: uSID Plan for GPU Backend Networks](https://srv6.md/ai/ai-fabric-design/): Design an SRv6 uSID AI backend fabric: multi-plane Clos, uSID addressing plan, static per-switch tables, SONiC CONFIG_DB and FRR config, NIC encapsulation, hardware support and security.
- [AI Fabric Telemetry with SRv6: Path-Aware Probing](https://srv6.md/ai/ai-fabric-telemetry/): How SRv6 source-routed probes give AI backend fabrics ground-truth path health: OpenAI's Clustermapper, fault localization by tier, data-plane probing vs ICMP, and the IETF tools that complement it.
- [AI Networking Glossary: GPU Fabric Terms for SRv6 Engineers](https://srv6.md/ai/ai-glossary/): Plain definitions of the AI networking terms network engineers meet when SRv6 enters GPU fabrics: RoCEv2, NCCL, all-reduce, packet spraying, multi-plane, uN, entropy value, JCT and more.
- [SRv6 for AI Standards Tracker: IETF Drafts, OCP MRC, SONiC](https://srv6.md/ai/ai-standards/): Every standard and draft on SRv6 for AI networking in one place: the IETF AI-backend draft, AI DCI and RDMA drafts, OCP MRC 1.0, Ultra Ethernet, and SONiC/SAI/FRR support. Updated October 2026.
- [SRv6 for AI Inference: WAN Design with uSID, Flex-Algo and SLA Planes](https://srv6.md/ai/inference-wan/): How SRv6 uSID carries distributed AI inference across provider WANs: Flex-Algo SLA planes, per-plane 5f00::/16 locators, BGP color steering, DCI design and connectivity models, from Cisco's October 2026 blueprint.
- [MRC and SRv6 Explained: OpenAI's AI Supercomputer Network](https://srv6.md/ai/mrc/): How MRC (Multipath Reliable Connection) uses static SRv6 uSID source routing in OpenAI's and Microsoft's GPU clusters: multi-plane Clos, entropy values, packet spraying, no BGP, results and limits.
- [SRv6 for Scale-Across AI: Multi-Datacenter Training and DCI](https://srv6.md/ai/scale-across/): How SRv6 traffic engineering carries AI traffic between data centers: Meta's SRv6 regional backbone, Alibaba's eCore for AI with per-job TE, China Telecom's cross-cluster training, and what is not SRv6.
- [SRv6 vs ECMP, Adaptive Routing and Ultra Ethernet for AI](https://srv6.md/ai/srv6-vs-ai-fabric-alternatives/): How SRv6 source routing compares with ECMP hashing, flowlets, switch adaptive routing (Spectrum-X, InfiniBand) and Ultra Ethernet packet spraying for GPU fabrics, and how they combine.

## Topics

- [SRv6 Fundamentals and Key Concepts: A Learning Path](https://srv6.md/topics/): SRv6 fundamentals and key concepts in order: SIDs, the SRH, network programming, uSID, Flex-Algo, TI-LFA, BGP services, OAM and migration, each with RFC references.
- [SRv6 L3VPN and EVPN: BGP Overlay Services (RFC 9252)](https://srv6.md/topics/bgp-overlay-services/): How BGP delivers L3VPN and EVPN services over SRv6: overlay architecture, service SIDs, the BGP SRv6 Service TLV from RFC 9252, and verification commands.
- [SRv6 in CLOS Data Centers: Deterministic Load Balancing](https://srv6.md/topics/clos-glb/): SRv6 in CLOS data center fabrics: the ECMP hash-collision problem, deterministic path placement, global load balancing with flowlets, and SRv6 vs VXLAN.
- [EVPN Multihoming Explained: ESI, DF Election, Aliasing, SRv6](https://srv6.md/topics/evpn-multihoming/): EVPN multihoming (EVPN-MH) explained: ESI types, all-active vs single-active, DF election (modulo, HRW, preference), aliasing, mass withdrawal and split-horizon over MPLS and SRv6.
- [Flex-Algo with SRv6: IGP Flexible Algorithm Guide](https://srv6.md/topics/flex-algorithm/): IGP Flexible Algorithm (Flex-Algo, RFC 9350) with SRv6: per-algorithm locators, latency and TE metrics, network slicing, configuration and verification.
- [SRv6 Glossary: Segment Routing over IPv6 Terminology](https://srv6.md/topics/glossary/): SRv6 glossary: plain-English definitions of 118 SRv6 terms, from SID, SRH and uSID to End.DT46, PSP, USD, Binding SID and TI-LFA, each tied to its RFC.
- [Host-Based SRv6: Linux, eBPF and VPP at the Edge](https://srv6.md/topics/host-based-srv6/): SRv6 at the host level with Linux kernel, eBPF, VPP, and the open-source ecosystem
- [Inter-Domain SRv6: Binding SID and Multi-Domain Design](https://srv6.md/topics/inter-domain/): Multi-domain SRv6 design patterns — Binding SID stitching, BGP-LS controllers, SID allocation, and domain boundary options
- [MPLS to SRv6 Migration: Strategies and Interworking](https://srv6.md/topics/interworking-migration/): Plan an MPLS or SR-MPLS to SRv6 migration: strategies, interworking gateways, Binding SID stitching, MTU, control-plane coexistence and a phased rollout.
- [SRv6 Micro-Loop Avoidance During IGP Convergence](https://srv6.md/topics/micro-loop-avoidance/): Preventing transient forwarding loops during IGP convergence using SRv6 local delay and explicit post-convergence paths
- [SRv6 Multicast: Replication Segments, Tree-SID, BIER](https://srv6.md/topics/multicast/): Multicast and broadcast delivery over SRv6 — replication segments, tree-SID, and BIER integration
- [SRv6 Network Programming: RFC 8986 Behavior Reference](https://srv6.md/topics/network-programming/): SRv6 network programming reference: every RFC 8986 endpoint and headend behavior, PSP/USP/USD flavors and RFC 9800 compressed SIDs, and where each is used.
- [SRv6 OAM and Troubleshooting: Ping, Traceroute, IOAM](https://srv6.md/topics/oam-troubleshooting/): Troubleshoot SRv6 networks: SRv6 ping and traceroute, IOAM, path tracing, in-situ performance measurement, common failure scenarios and a step-by-step playbook.
- [SRv6 Performance and Scaling: Overhead and MTU](https://srv6.md/topics/performance-scaling/): SRv6 performance and scale: encapsulation overhead, MTU impact and sizing, hardware forwarding limits, and the scaling considerations that matter in production.
- [SRv6 QoS: Traffic Class, DSCP and Per-Policy QoS](https://srv6.md/topics/qos/): Quality of Service mechanisms in SRv6 — traffic class, DSCP, Flex-Algo constraints, and per-policy QoS
- [SRv6 Security: HMAC, Filtering and Attack Mitigation](https://srv6.md/topics/security/): SRv6 security in depth: threat model, SRH HMAC, infrastructure ACL filtering, SRv6-specific attack vectors, implementation CVEs and comparison with MPLS.
- [SRv6 SID Structure: Locator, Function and Arguments](https://srv6.md/topics/sid-structure/): Understand the SRv6 SID structure. Learn how the 128-bit Segment Identifier encodes locator, function, and arguments, and how the IANA-allocated 5f00::/16 block from RFC 9602 fits in.
- [SRv6 on SONiC and SAI: Open Networking Stack](https://srv6.md/topics/sonic-sai/): How SRv6 runs on SONiC: the Switch Abstraction Interface (SAI), SRv6 features in SONiC, the FRRouting control plane, and whitebox hardware support.
- [SR Policy Explained (RFC 9256): Color, ODN and Binding SID](https://srv6.md/topics/sr-policy/): SR Policy explained: color and endpoint, candidate paths, explicit and dynamic segment lists, on-demand next hop (ODN), PCE, binding SID and automated steering with SRv6.
- [SRv6 Header (SRH) Format and Packet Walk, Step by Step](https://srv6.md/topics/srh-packet-walk/): Step-by-step SRv6 packet walk through the Segment Routing Header (RFC 8754): SRH format, PSP/USP/USD flavors, TLVs, reduced encapsulation and verification.
- [SRv6 Performance Measurement (SRPM): Delay and Loss](https://srv6.md/topics/srpm/): SRv6 performance measurement with STAMP, alternate-marking, and color-aware PM for delay, loss, and jitter monitoring across SRv6 networks.
- [SRv6 vs MPLS and SR-MPLS: Differences, Overhead and When to Use Each](https://srv6.md/topics/srv6-vs-sr-mpls/): SRv6 vs MPLS compared: classic MPLS (LDP, RSVP-TE), SR-MPLS and SRv6 side by side. Header overhead with real numbers, hardware, inter-domain, security, operations and when to choose each.
- [SRv6 Telemetry and Monitoring: IPFIX, YANG, gNMI](https://srv6.md/topics/telemetry/): Monitor SRv6 networks: what to measure, streaming telemetry, SRv6 YANG models, IPFIX export (RFC 9487), an open-source monitoring stack and what to alert on.
- [TI-LFA (RFC 9855): Segment Routing Fast Reroute Explained](https://srv6.md/topics/ti-lfa/): TI-LFA explained: P-space, Q-space and PQ nodes with a worked example, link vs node vs SRLG protection, RFC 9855, SRv6 repair, and Cisco IOS-XR, IOS-XE and Junos configs.
- [uSID (SRv6 Micro-SID) Explained: Compression and RFC 9800](https://srv6.md/topics/usid-compression/): How SRv6 micro-SIDs (uSID, RFC 9800) shrink header overhead: packing, overhead comparison with classic SRv6, uSID vs G-SRv6, configuration and adoption.
- [What is SRv6? IPv6 Segment Routing Explained (Guide)](https://srv6.md/topics/what-is-srv6/): SRv6 explained: what Segment Routing over IPv6 is, how SIDs and the SRH work, a hop-by-hop packet walk, uSID, SRv6 vs IPv6 and MPLS, use cases and FAQ.

## Use Cases

- [SRv6 Use Cases: Real-World Applications](https://srv6.md/use-cases/): Discover SRv6 use cases and real-world applications. See how Segment Routing over IPv6 powers traffic engineering, VPNs, and service chaining.
- [SRv6 for 5G Transport: Backhaul, Slicing and MUP](https://srv6.md/use-cases/5g-transport/): SRv6 as the converged 5G transport: backhaul, midhaul and fronthaul architecture, network slicing, the SRv6 Mobile User Plane (MUP) and operator deployments.
- [SRv6 for AI Training Networks: Fixing ECMP Hash Collisions](https://srv6.md/use-cases/ai-networking/): The AI training use case for SRv6: why ECMP hash collisions slow GPU training, how deterministic SRv6 uSID path placement fixes them, and a summary of MRC in production.
- [Cloud-Native SRv6 Backbone: From SR-MPLS/GRE to SRv6](https://srv6.md/use-cases/cloud-native-backbone/): Migrating a cloud backbone from SR-MPLS over GRE to one native SRv6 domain: the problem, ECMP entropy in the cloud, stack simplification and outcomes.
- [SRv6 Deployments: Who Runs SRv6 in Production](https://srv6.md/use-cases/deployments/): Directory of public SRv6 production deployments: telecom operators, hyperscalers, AI clusters and public sector, each linked to the original announcement.
- [Quantum-Safe SRv6 for Mission-Critical Networks](https://srv6.md/use-cases/mission-critical/): Quantum-safe SRv6 fabrics for defense and mission-critical WANs: DDIL survivability, post-quantum MACsec and IPsec, Flex-Algo slicing and TI-LFA design rules.
- [SRv6 Network Slicing with Flex-Algo and SR Policy](https://srv6.md/use-cases/network-slicing/): End-to-end network slicing with SRv6 using Flex-Algorithm, QoS, and SR Policy color steering for 5G, enterprise, and data center
- [SRv6 over Satellite: LEO Connectivity Use Case](https://srv6.md/use-cases/satellite-connectivity/): SRv6 overlay services over LEO satellite transport: why SRv6 fits satellite links, architecture concepts, applicable SRv6 behaviors and industry validation.
- [SD-WAN and SRv6: Native Underlay Path Control](https://srv6.md/use-cases/sd-wan/): How SRv6 enhances SD-WAN with native underlay path control, simplified overlays, and end-to-end policy enforcement
- [SRv6 Service Function Chaining (SFC) and Dynamic Service Chaining](https://srv6.md/use-cases/service-chaining/): Service function chaining with SRv6: why traditional SFC falls short, packet walk through a service chain, SRv6 proxy behaviors and dynamic chain changes.
- [SRv6 Traffic Engineering with SR Policies](https://srv6.md/use-cases/traffic-engineering/): Learn SRv6 traffic engineering with SR Policies. Steer traffic along explicit paths using Segment Routing over IPv6 for latency and bandwidth optimization.
- [SRv6 VPN Services: L3VPN, EVPN-VPWS and EVPN-ELAN](https://srv6.md/use-cases/vpn-services/): L3VPN and L2VPN services with SRv6 — End.DT4/DT6 for L3, EVPN-VPWS (E-Line), EVPN-ELAN, and E-Tree for L2

## Implementations

- [SRv6 Implementations: Cisco, Juniper, Arista, Nokia, FRR](https://srv6.md/implementations/): SRv6 implementations on Linux, Cisco IOS-XR, Juniper, Arista EOS, Nokia SR OS, FRRouting, and SONiC. Practical deployment guides for Segment Routing over IPv6.
- [SRv6 on Arista EOS: uSID Configuration and Platforms](https://srv6.md/implementations/arista-eos/): SRv6 uSID support on Arista EOS — uN, static uA, IS-IS, counters, SSU, and supported platforms
- [SRv6 with Cilium: eBPF Datapath and L3VPN for Kubernetes](https://srv6.md/implementations/cilium/): What SRv6 in Cilium really is: a hidden beta eBPF datapath in open-source Cilium since 1.13, and SRv6 L3VPN with uSID in Isovalent Enterprise for Cilium.
- [SRv6 on Cisco IOS-XE: uSID Configuration Guide](https://srv6.md/implementations/cisco-ios-xe/): Configure SRv6 uSID on Cisco IOS-XE (ASR 1000, Catalyst 8000, 8000 Secure Routers) since 17.12.1a: F3216 locators, IS-IS, per-VRF L3VPN, Flex-Algo and TI-LFA.
- [SRv6 on Cisco IOS-XR: uSID and L3VPN Configuration](https://srv6.md/implementations/cisco-ios-xr/): Configure SRv6 on Cisco IOS-XR: supported NCS, ASR 9000 and Cisco 8000 platforms and releases, uSID locator and IS-IS setup, L3VPN over SRv6, and verification.
- [SRv6 on FRRouting (FRR): uSID, L3VPN and Config](https://srv6.md/implementations/frrouting/): Run SRv6 on FRRouting (FRR): support status from 8.1 to 10.7, uSID locators, IS-IS and L3VPN over SRv6, global-table services, BGP-LS and what is still missing.
- [Juniper SRv6 on Junos: uSID, L3VPN, Flex-Algo and TI-LFA Guide](https://srv6.md/implementations/juniper/): Configure SRv6 on Juniper Junos and Junos Evolved: platforms and releases, uSID locators, IS-IS, L3VPN and Internet over SRv6, Flex-Algo, TI-LFA and verification.
- [SRv6 on Linux: Kernel Behaviors, iproute2 Recipes and a Lab](https://srv6.md/implementations/linux-kernel/): SRv6 in the Linux kernel: which seg6 behaviors landed in which kernel, iproute2 recipes for encap and seg6local, a tested two-namespace lab and troubleshooting.
- [SRv6 on Nokia SR OS: Classic SIDs and uSID](https://srv6.md/implementations/nokia-sros/): SRv6 on Nokia SR OS — classic SIDs and micro-segment (uSID) SRv6 side by side, services, protection and platforms
- [SRv6 on SONiC: Status and Architecture](https://srv6.md/implementations/sonic/): SRv6 in the SONiC network OS: release-by-release status from 202111, uSID and static CONFIG_DB SIDs for AI fabrics, and the SAI/orchagent architecture with FRR.
- [SRv6 Support Matrix: Vendor and Open-Source Support](https://srv6.md/implementations/support-matrix/): Which SRv6 behaviors, uSID, IS-IS, BGP services, TI-LFA, Flex-Algo and OAM features each platform supports, with minimum releases and a source for every cell.
- [Vinbero: Go and eBPF SRv6 Data Plane](https://srv6.md/implementations/vinbero/): SRv6 with Vinbero — a Go daemon whose eBPF data plane implements the RFC 8986 behaviors, EVPN L2VPN with multi-homing, the RFC 9433 mobile user plane, and service programming proxies, driven by an in-process GoBGP speaker.
- [zebra-rs: Rust Routing Stack with an eBPF SRv6 Data Plane](https://srv6.md/implementations/zebra-rs/): SRv6 with zebra-rs and its cradle-rs eBPF data plane — a Rust routing stack (IS-IS, OSPFv3, BGP) whose learned routes program an XDP/TC data plane implementing the full RFC 8986 behavior set plus RFC 9800 uSID and REPLACE-C-SID compression.

## Labs

- [SRv6 Labs: Free Hands-On Labs with netlab, Containerlab, GNS3](https://srv6.md/labs/): Practice SRv6 hands-on with free virtual labs: netlab, Containerlab and GNS3 environments using FRR, Linux and vendor router images. No hardware required.
- [SRv6 Lab with Containerlab: Step-by-Step Topology](https://srv6.md/labs/containerlab/): Free SRv6 lab with Containerlab and FRRouting: IS-IS uSID locators, an SRv6 path steered through a transit node, and SRH checks at packet level.
- [SRv6 Lab with GNS3: Emulating Vendor Routers](https://srv6.md/labs/gns3/): Emulate an SRv6 network in GNS3 with vendor router images such as Cisco IOS-XR and Juniper Junos: prerequisites, topology design and practical lab tips.
- [SRv6 Lab with netlab: Ready-Made Multi-Vendor Topologies](https://srv6.md/labs/netlab/): Spin up preconfigured SRv6 labs with netlab: IS-IS, unnumbered core, multivendor, IPv4 islands, BGP-free core and L3VPN topologies on FRR, IOS XE/XR and Junos.
- [SRv6 pcap Library: Wireshark Captures and SRH Filters](https://srv6.md/labs/pcaps/): Free annotated SRv6 packet captures (pcapng) from a real Linux lab: H.Encaps, End.X, End.DT4/DT6/DT46, End.DX2, uSID, HMAC, and SRH Wireshark filters.

## RFCs & Standards

- [Segment Routing and SRv6 RFCs: Complete IETF Reference](https://srv6.md/rfcs/): Every SRv6 RFC explained: SRH, network programming, uSID compression, BGP services, IGP extensions, SR Policy, OAM and multicast, with plain-language summaries.
- [RFC 10038 Explained: Distributing SRv6 Locators via DHCPv6](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc10038/): RFC 10038 explained in plain language: Distributing the SRv6 Locator Using DHCPv6 — IA_SRV6_LOCATOR and IA Locator options. What it defines, how it works and how it fits into SRv6 networks.
- [RFC 8402 Explained: Segment Routing Architecture](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc8402/): RFC 8402 explained: the Segment Routing architecture behind SR-MPLS and SRv6. Prefix, adjacency, anycast and binding SIDs, the SRGB, and how SR replaces LDP and RSVP-TE.
- [RFC 8754 Explained: IPv6 Segment Routing Header (SRH)](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc8754/): RFC 8754 explained: the IPv6 Segment Routing Header (Routing Type 4) field by field, Segments Left processing, TLVs and HMAC, and the security rules for SRv6 domains.
- [RFC 8986 Explained: SRv6 Network Programming](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc8986/): RFC 8986 explained: SRv6 Network Programming. The locator:function:argument SID, the End, End.X, End.DT4/DT6/DT46, End.B6 and H.Encaps behaviors, and PSP/USP/USD flavors.
- [RFC 9252 Explained: BGP Overlay Services over SRv6](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc9252/): RFC 9252 explained: how BGP carries SRv6 service SIDs for L3VPN, EVPN and Internet services. SRv6 Services TLVs, the SID Structure sub-TLV, and End.DT and End.DX behaviors.
- [RFC 9256 Explained: Segment Routing Policy Architecture](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc9256/): RFC 9256 explained: the SR Policy architecture. Headend, color and endpoint, candidate paths and preference, binding SID, and automated steering of BGP routes by color.
- [RFC 9259 Explained: SRv6 OAM, Ping and Traceroute](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc9259/): RFC 9259 explained: OAM in SRv6 networks. The SRH O-flag, ping and traceroute to SRv6 SIDs, and how standard IPv6 tools troubleshoot SRv6 paths.
- [RFC 9350 Explained: IGP Flexible Algorithm (Flex-Algo)](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc9350/): RFC 9350 explained: IGP Flexible Algorithm. Flex-Algo definitions (metric type, affinities, SRLG exclusion), algorithms 128-255, and per-algorithm SRv6 locators for slicing.
- [RFC 9352 Explained: IS-IS Extensions for SRv6](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc9352/): RFC 9352 explained: IS-IS extensions for SRv6. The SRv6 Locator TLV, End and End.X SID sub-TLVs, the SID Structure sub-sub-TLV, SRv6 capabilities and MSD advertisement.
- [RFC 9433 Explained: SRv6 Mobile User Plane (MUP)](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc9433/): RFC 9433 explained: SRv6 for the 5G mobile user plane (MUP). SRv6 in place of GTP-U, the End.M.GTP6 and End.M.GTP4.E behaviors, and stateless GTP interworking.
- [RFC 9487 Explained: Exporting SRv6 Information in IPFIX](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc9487/): RFC 9487 explained: exporting SRv6 data in IPFIX. Active SID, segment list, Segments Left, endpoint behavior and SRH flags for flow monitoring of SRv6 traffic.
- [RFC 9513 Explained: OSPFv3 Extensions for SRv6](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc9513/): RFC 9513 explained: OSPFv3 extensions for SRv6. The SRv6 Locator LSA and TLVs, End and End.X SIDs, SRv6 capabilities and MSD: the OSPFv3 counterpart of RFC 9352.
- [RFC 9514 Explained: BGP-LS Extensions for SRv6](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc9514/): RFC 9514 explained: BGP-LS extensions for SRv6. How locators, End and End.X SIDs and the SID structure reach controllers and PCEs for path computation.
- [RFC 9524 Explained: SR Replication Segment for Multicast](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc9524/): RFC 9524 explained in plain language: Segment Routing Replication for Multipoint Service Delivery (Replication segment and End.Replicate). What it defines, how it works and how it fits into SRv6 networks.
- [RFC 9602 Explained: SRv6 SIDs and the 5f00::/16 Block](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc9602/): RFC 9602 explained: where SRv6 SIDs fit in the IPv6 addressing architecture, and the 5f00::/16 block IANA reserved for SRv6 SIDs, with edge filtering guidance.
- [RFC 9603 Explained: PCEP Extensions for SRv6](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc9603/): RFC 9603 explained in plain language: PCEP Extensions for IPv6 Segment Routing — SRv6 path setup type, SRv6-ERO and SRv6-RRO. What it defines, how it works and how it fits into SRv6 networks.
- [RFC 9723 Explained: BGP Colored Prefix Routing for SRv6](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc9723/): RFC 9723 explained in plain language: BGP Colored Prefix Routing (CPR) for SRv6 services — intent-aware inter-domain paths via colored locators. What it defines, how it works and how it fits into SRv6 networks.
- [RFC 9800 Explained: SRv6 uSID Compression (C-SID)](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc9800/): RFC 9800 explained: compressed SRv6 SIDs. The NEXT-C-SID (uSID) and REPLACE-C-SID flavors, the F3216 format, how a container shifts, and when no SRH is needed at all.
- [RFC 9819 Explained: Argument Signaling for SRv6 BGP Services](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc9819/): RFC 9819 explained in plain language: Argument Signaling for BGP Services in SRv6 — End.DT2M ESI filtering argument (updates RFC 9252). What it defines, how it works and how it fits into SRv6 networks.
- [RFC 9830 Explained: Advertising SR Policies in BGP](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc9830/): RFC 9830 explained: the BGP SR Policy SAFI (73) that lets controllers push SR Policy candidate paths to headends, with SRv6 Binding SIDs and SRv6 segment encoding.
- [RFC 9855 Explained: TI-LFA Fast Reroute](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc9855/): RFC 9855 explained: TI-LFA, Segment Routing fast reroute with full topology coverage. Post-convergence repair paths, P and Q spaces, and link, node and SRLG protection.
- [RFC 9857 Explained: SR Policies in BGP-LS](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc9857/): Advertisement of Segment Routing Policies Using BGP-LS — reporting SR Policy candidate path state to controllers
- [RFC 9860 Explained: MoFRR Based on TI-LFA](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc9860/): RFC 9860 explained in plain language: Multicast-only Fast Reroute (MoFRR) based on TI-LFA — PIM secondary joins along TI-LFA repair paths. What it defines, how it works and how it fits into SRv6 networks.
- [RFC 9960 Explained: Segment Routing P2MP Policy (Tree-SID)](https://srv6.md/rfcs/rfc9960/): RFC 9960 explained in plain language: Segment Routing Point-to-Multipoint (P2MP) Policy — Tree-SID architecture built from Replication segments. What it defines, how it works and how it fits into SRv6 networks.

## En español (Spanish)

- [SRv6 en español: guía de Segment Routing sobre IPv6](https://srv6.md/es/): Guía abierta de SRv6 en español: qué es Segment Routing sobre IPv6, cómo funcionan los SID, la cabecera SRH y uSID, y en qué se diferencia de MPLS. Gratis y open source.
- [Cabecera SRH de SRv6: recorrido del paquete paso a paso](https://srv6.md/es/cabecera-srh/): Cómo funciona la Segment Routing Header (SRH) de SRv6 (RFC 8754): formato, Segments Left, recorrido de un paquete nodo por nodo, sabores PSP/USP/USD, TLVs y H.Encaps.Red.
- [Estructura del SID en SRv6: Locator, función y argumentos](https://srv6.md/es/estructura-del-sid/): Cómo se compone un SID de SRv6 de 128 bits: Locator, función y argumentos, el bloque 5f00::/16 asignado por IANA (RFC 9602) y cómo filtrarlo en los bordes del dominio.
- [SRv6 para IA: guía completa de SRv6 en redes de IA](https://srv6.md/es/ia/): SRv6 para IA en español: quién lo usa (OpenAI, Microsoft, Oracle, Meta, Alibaba, Google), cómo funcionan MRC y el enrutamiento de origen con uSID en fabrics de GPU, scale-across, estándares y preguntas frecuentes.
- [¿Qué es SRv6? Segment Routing sobre IPv6 explicado](https://srv6.md/es/que-es-srv6/): Qué es SRv6 y cómo funciona: SID, cabecera SRH, recorrido de un paquete salto a salto, uSID, diferencias con IPv6 y MPLS, casos de uso y preguntas frecuentes.
- [SRv6 vs MPLS y SR-MPLS: diferencias, overhead y cuándo usar cada uno](https://srv6.md/es/srv6-vs-sr-mpls/): SRv6 vs MPLS: comparación de MPLS clásico (LDP, RSVP-TE), SR-MPLS y SRv6. Overhead con números reales, hardware, seguridad, operación y cuándo elegir cada uno.
- [uSID en SRv6: compresión de micro-SID explicada](https://srv6.md/es/usid/): Qué es uSID (micro-SID) en SRv6 y cómo reduce la sobrecarga del encabezado: estructura, operación shift-and-lookup, comparación con SRv6 clásico, uSID vs G-SRv6 y RFC 9800.

## 日本語 (Japanese)

- [SRv6 日本語ガイド｜Segment Routing over IPv6 入門](https://srv6.md/ja/): SRv6の日本語ガイド。Segment Routing over IPv6とは何か、SIDの構造、SRH、uSIDの仕組み、MPLSとの違いをネットワークエンジニア向けに解説する、無料のオープンソース知識ベースです。
- [SRv6 AIネットワーク完全ガイド｜MRCとuSIDの仕組み](https://srv6.md/ja/ai/): AIネットワークにおけるSRv6の日本語ガイド。OpenAI、Microsoft、OracleがMRCとスタティックSRv6 uSIDでGPUファブリックを運用する仕組み、Meta・AlibabaのScale-Across、標準化動向、よくある質問まで解説します。
- [SRv6 SIDの構造：Locator・Function・Argumentsとは](https://srv6.md/ja/sid-structure/): SRv6 SIDの構造を解説。128ビットのSegment IdentifierがLocator、Function、Argumentsをどうエンコードするか、IANAが割り当てた5f00::/16（RFC 9602）とドメイン境界でのフィルタリングまで。
- [SRv6のSRH（Segment Routing Header）とパケット処理](https://srv6.md/ja/srh-packet-walk/): SRv6のSegment Routing Header（SRH、RFC 8754）を図解。フォーマット、Segments Left、ノードごとのパケットウォーク、PSP/USP/USDフレーバー、TLV、H.Encaps.Red、確認コマンドまで。
- [SRv6 vs MPLS・SR-MPLS：違い、オーバーヘッド、使い分け](https://srv6.md/ja/srv6-vs-sr-mpls/): SRv6 vs MPLSを比較。従来のMPLS（LDP、RSVP-TE）、SR-MPLS、SRv6を並べ、ヘッダーのオーバーヘッドを実数値で示し、ハードウェア、ドメイン間、セキュリティ、運用、使い分けまで解説します。
- [SRv6 uSID（マイクロSID）とは：SID圧縮の仕組み](https://srv6.md/ja/usid/): SRv6のuSID（マイクロSID、RFC 9800）がヘッダーのオーバーヘッドをどう削減するかを解説。コンテナの構造、シフト＆ルックアップ動作、従来のSRv6との比較、uSIDとG-SRv6の違い、設定例まで。
- [SRv6とは？仕組みとメリットをわかりやすく解説](https://srv6.md/ja/what-is-srv6/): SRv6（Segment Routing over IPv6）とは何かを図解。SID、SRH、パケットの転送の流れ、uSID、IPv6やMPLSとの違い、ユースケース、よくある質問まで一通り解説します。
